author: Mike Ceide
title: FedEx steps up again with lucrative new sponsorship deal with University of Memphis - NewsBreak
text: MEMPHIS — The Big XII may have said no but the Memphis Tigers aren’t standing pat. On Wednesday, the University of Memphis announced a new sponsorship deal with FedEx. One headlined by what’s expected to be a college football first. The iconic FedEx logo will be prominently featured in the endzones at Simmons Bank Liberty Stadium this season with more signage on the sidelines with the motto— Moving Memphis Athletics forward… together. While financial terms were not released, this new deal between the U of M and FedEx replaces the one announced back in 2024 when the logistics giant pledged 25 million dollars over five years to the Tigers’ Name, Image and Likeness fund. This new money is expected to be used in revenue sharing at the U of M, with schools now allowed to spend upwards of 20-million dollars. Memphis Athletic Director Dr. Ed Scott released this statement after Wednesday’s announcement, “This partnership enhances opportunities for our student-athletes, strengthens our athletics program and benefits the entire city of Memphis. This strategic shift positions Tiger nation for long-term success in the ever-changing college athletics landscape.” For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to WREG.com.
